name: Max Healthcare
title: Transcript of Earnings Call held on November 3, 2026

read.thesis: Q2 revenue +20% YoY and EBITDA margin flat at 26.8% despite 14% more beds; occupancy steady at 77%, with oncology drag lapping from Q3 and greenfield drag guided at INR 40-50 crore.

utilisation.quote: occupancy holding steady at 77% , despite a 14% year-on-year increase in operational bed capacity

capex.peers_comment: One competitor recently commissioned a new Gurugram hospital; management did not comment on its capacity beyond that.
capex.quote: the Board has approved an investment of INR 415 crore towards addition of 209 brownfield beds

triggers.label: Board approves INR 415 cr brownfield expansion
triggers.quote: the Board has approved an investment of INR 415 crore towards addition of 209 brownfield beds

triggers.label: Occupancy flat at 77% on 14% more beds
triggers.quote: occupancy holding steady at 77% , despite a 14% year-on-year increase in operational bed capacity

triggers.label: IP ARPP +8% YoY to INR 2.31 lakh
triggers.quote: Average revenue per patient (IP ARPP) for the quarter stood at INR 2.31 lakhs, growing by 8% year-on-year

triggers.label: De-empanelment of BLK from CGHS and Railways
triggers.quote: we de-empanelled BLK in May for CGHS and then the Railways, etc., because they were not paying us

triggers.label: Oncology drag to lap from Q3
triggers.quote: Yes, that should be the case because you are coming off a lower base.

guidance.value: Revenue growth expected to accelerate into Q3 and Q4 on lower base
guidance.quote: Yes, that should be the case because you are coming off a lower base.

guidance.value: peak loss INR 40-50 crore; breakeven about one year
guidance.quote: If I was to draw a line in the sand, it would be around INR 40-50 crore.
We expect to commission the remaining 140 beds after Diwali puja.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Nanavati and Max Smart EBITDA ramp
prior_guidance_check.quote: Mohali was the first to open, and we broke even in the first quarter, and then it ramped up. Similar was the experience at Nanavati-Max in Mumbai.
the net debt-to-EBITDA ratio continued to remain below 1

red_flags.label: Trade margin cap on non-scheduled drugs, impact not quantified
red_flags.quote: We are still working it out.

red_flags.label: Payor mix shift: CGHS/institutional revenue share falling, de-empanelments
red_flags.quote: we de-empanelled BLK in May for CGHS and then the Railways, etc., because they were not paying us

evasions.topic: Trade margin cap impact on pharmacy/oncology
evasions.quote: We are still working it out.
We would not be able to tell you. We know the overall pharmacy numbers
We do not share specific hospital level occupancy numbers.
